question: Which of the following banks signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Indo-Tibetan Border Police in February 2025 to provide financial and insurance benefits?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab National Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **February 2025**, **Punjab National Bank (PNB)** entered into a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with the **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)** to provide a comprehensive package of financial services and insurance benefits to its personnel.
 
• The agreement was signed at the **ITBP Headquarters** located in **New Delhi**, in the presence of senior officials from both the **bank** and the **paramilitary force**.
 
• Under this **MoU**, the **PNB Rakshak Plus** scheme will be extended to the **ITBP** personnel, which is a specialized salary account designed specifically for the **Indian Defense Forces** and **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)**.
 
• The primary **function** of this collaboration is to ensure enhanced **social security** and **financial inclusion** for the brave jawans guarding the **Himalayan borders** of the country</st
